meta.title: Famling · Tinglan / Selkirk Rex / Golden Retriever
meta.description: Shows a pixel mini pet (Tinglan, Selkirk Rex cat, Golden Retriever) below the DSH account area; a role IS its theme bundle, and the content center is organized as Roles / Customize / Packs / Market. Applying a role at once changes the voice policy, dialogue mode and appearance (bubbles, panels, background, font); component overrides and role-default restore are local. Content packs use the reserved v3 pure-data contract with a mandatory research-only declaration; no network, no script execution.
